HOW IT WORKS

From the manufacturer.
Through our hands.
To your home.

Our service brings together global product sourcing, warehouse inspection and onward delivery. Here is how your order moves from the manufacturer to your home, and what the service costs.

A clear journey for every order.

01

Choose your product

Browse the collection. Check the material, dimensions, finish, manufacturer and source notes. Ask us to confirm anything unclear.

02

Confirm one AUD total

We confirm the exact variant, availability, delivery scope and lead time. Your total includes the initial product price, our 10% service fee and agreed freight, inspection, duties and applicable tax.

03

Manufacturer to warehouse

After payment is confirmed, we arrange the agreed product from the manufacturer to our receiving warehouse. Our sourcing focus includes China, Thailand, India and beyond; each listing identifies its actual source.

04

Inspect before dispatch

We check the agreed product, quantity, dimensions, finish, function where practicable and packaging. We record the result. Failed items stay on hold while we resolve the problem.

05

Deliver to you

Only an order that passes inspection proceeds to onward shipping. View recorded tracking in My orders. Contact FI directly if the delivery is damaged, incomplete or incorrect.

06

Share your experience

After a real paid order is recorded as delivered, review the product from My orders. We publish genuine positive and negative experiences under the same rules.

ONE INCLUSIVE AUD PRICE

10% of the initial product price.

Our service fee is calculated on the manufacturer’s product price converted to AUD. It is not calculated on freight, duties or tax. The final total also includes the agreed delivery and inspection costs and applicable tax.

10%

For example: an A$100 manufacturer product price has a A$10 FI service fee. The final displayed total also includes all agreed costs for the stated delivery scope, confirmed before payment.

If a check fails, shipping waits.

We resolve the issue with the manufacturer before dispatch. We do not substitute another product without your agreement. If the agreed order cannot be supplied, we explain your options and arrange the refund due.

Inspection reduces defect risk; hidden problems and transit damage can still happen. Our returns policy explains how FI puts things right.

EVIDENCE BEFORE CLAIMS

Know what has been checked.

Supplier links, specifications and research notes explain each listing. AI catalogue renders are labelled. A supplier listing or research score is not proof that we have physically inspected stock.

Our condition promise

Every order must pass the agreed warehouse checks before dispatch. If a product arrives damaged or defective, contact FI for the appropriate repair, replacement or refund. Inspection does not remove your Australian Consumer Law rights or detect every hidden defect.
